# core

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-001 — Validate generic OKF bundles](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-001.md) — The generic okf-schema layer validates and manages ordinary OKF bundles.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-002 — Create bundles and concepts](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-002.md) — When a user initializes a bundle or creates a concept, okf-schema SHALL create the requested structure and metadata without overwriting an existing target.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-003 — Normalize bundle formatting](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-003.md) — When formatting or linting is requested, okf-schema SHALL normalize supported frontmatter and Markdown while preserving comments, semantic values, and authored content.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-004 — Maintain indexes and superseded links](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-004.md) — When bundle maintenance is requested, okf-schema SHALL regenerate deterministic indexes and rewrite resolvable links to superseding concepts while reporting deferred rewrites.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-005 — Inspect and query bundle knowledge](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-005.md) — When a user inspects an OKF bundle, okf-schema SHALL provide deterministic list, show, search, graph, backlink, and statistics results without modifying the bundle.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-006 — Validate OKF 0.2 provenance and lifecycle](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-006.md) — When OKF 0.2 metadata is validated, okf-schema SHALL enforce provenance, verification, lifecycle, resource, trust-tier, and staleness rules with actionable findings.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-007 — Interpret and optionally check schema-declared file references](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-CORE-007.md) — When annotated file targets are explicitly checked, the base okf-schema API SHALL resolve applicable x-okf-link string annotations and report invalid or skipped targets without modifying document values.
